annotations.text:
Direction C, rebuilt around the date
Each card's date is a tab that breaks the photo's bottom edge, so the day reads before the title. The strip under the header is the whole stay: bold green ticks on event days, faint on the rest.
Green is the system now (fern-800 headings and buttons, sage ink and meta). Sienna is kept for three things only: the header rule, the next-up date, and Tickets.

Sample states, not real data
'Tickets' on Trivia night and 'in 5 days' (as if viewed Mon Oct 5) show the ticketed and next-up states. Photo blocks are placeholders. The phone artboard shows the full page, not one screenful.

A · Tour dates
A band's date list: big day numerals, one row per event. The next event gets the sienna.
Tradeoff: photos are a footnote, not the show.

B · The week as a grid
Eight day columns; each event spans its day. The gaps are the information.
Tradeoff: two layouts to maintain; adjacent events have to stagger.

C · Three posters (chosen)
Image-led cards in a row. Built out on the Come See page with the date tab and the green system.

D · Next up
The upcoming event as hero with a countdown; the rest queue below.
Tradeoff: two shapes to scan; after the last event it is just a list.
